title: Settings
languageHint: Applies immediately to both windows and Master names.
languageAutoHint: Follows the Windows display language. Now: {{language}}
adapterChoose: Choose the interface your game connection uses.
adapterLocked: Stop the capture to change the interface.
autoStartCaptureHint: Open WWlogs before you log in to the game. A capture started after login cannot decode that connection.
invalid: Settings could not be loaded safely. Defaults are in use.
saveFailed: Preferences could not be saved. Previous settings are preserved.
loadFailed: Preferences could not be loaded. Defaults are shown.
reduceMotionHint: Turns off transitions and counting numbers; values still update at once. Windows' own animation setting is also respected.
clickThroughHint: When on, mouse input passes through the overlay and never interrupts the game.
editModeHint: Temporarily accepts the mouse so you can drag and resize. Your settings return when you finish.
mainWindowNote: Saved automatically; the next launch opens the same way
opacityHint: Affects the panel background only; text stays clear.
scaleHint: Scales the window and everything in it, {{min}}–{{max}}%. The position is kept and a size you set scales with it; a window larger than the screen stays inside it.
geometryReset: Saved overlay placement was invalid and has been reset.

licenses.intro: The fonts built into this application and their licenses. License terms are shown in their original language and are not translated.
licenses.linkFailed: The browser could not be opened. Go to the address manually.

usageOf.noto: Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Korean

updateIntervalHint: Shared by the Dashboard and both Overlays, including effect countdowns. Only the screen update rate changes; every combat event is still counted.

effectsLegend.title: Effect strip
effectsLegend.gameIcon: Icon: the icon the game itself shows for this effect in its HUD. The colored area inside is the share of the duration left, below it are the estimated seconds left, and at the top right are the stacks from two.
effectsLegend.generic: Dim icon in a narrow cell: an icon the game shares across many effects (such as crossed swords), so it cannot tell them apart.
effectsLegend.gauge: Narrow cell: the game has no icon for this effect. The small center mark is its kind: square changes a combat attribute, circle is another combat state, diamond relates to enemies. Direction and meaning are not confirmed.
effectsLegend.color: Fill color: the element the effect's definition states; gray when it states none or it cannot be confirmed. Color does not mean buff or debuff.
effectsLegend.untimed: Hatched with no seconds: the game gives no reliable time.
effectsLegend.more: +N: effects that do not fit the width of the window. The window can be widened in Edit Mode.
effectsLegend.order: Effects run left to right by when they end: soonest first, effects without a time last.
effectsLegend.noNames: Effects are shown without names, as in the game; most effects have no name in the game data.
